info.name: API Investigation Lab
info.description: Fictional advising API investigation. Import the environment template and fill it locally from the private handout. User identity is explicit on every request; no mutable current-user setting is used. Run the 00 Deterministic automated sequence folder from a fresh reset. The eight nested sections execute in order. Folder 01 Exploratory requests is separate and each request states its prerequisites.

exec: pm.test('Expected HTTP status ' + expected, function () { pm.response.to.have.status(expected); });
let body = {}; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}

pm.test('Standard error envelope and request ID', function () { pm.expect(body.error).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.error.code).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.requestId).to.be.a('string'); });
if (code) pm.test('Stable error code: ' + code, function () { pm.expect(body.error.code).to.eql(code); });

if (expected < 400 && pm.request.method === 'GET' && (path === '/api/slots' || path === '/api/bookings')) pm.test('Paginated response shape', function () { pm.expect(body.pagination.limit).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.pagination.offset).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.pagination).to.have.property('nextOffset'); pm.expect(body.pagination.hasMore).to.be.a('boolean'); });

if (expected === 201 && pm.request.method === 'POST' && path === '/api/bookings') pm.test('Created booking fields', function () { ['id','studentId','slotId','status'].forEach(function (key) { pm.expect(body.data).to.have.property(key); }); });
pm.test('No credential hashes are returned', function () { const text = JSON.stringify(body); pm.expect(text).not.to.include('tokenHash'); pm.expect(text).not.to.include('keyHash'); });

pm.test('Public response excludes private fields', function () { rows.forEach(function (row) { pm.expect(row).not.to.have.property('email'); pm.expect(row).not.to.have.property('internalNote'); pm.expect(row).not.to.have.property('privateNote'); pm.expect(row).not.to.have.property('studentId'); }); });

if (isDetail && auth.indexOf(pm.environment.get('advisorToken')) !== -1) pm.test('Assigned advisor receives privateNote', function () { rows.forEach(function (row) { pm.expect(row).to.have.property('privateNote'); }); });
else pm.test('Student and booking-list responses omit privateNote', function () { rows.forEach(function (row) { pm.expect(row).not.to.have.property('privateNote'); }); });

item.name: 00 Deterministic automated sequence - run this folder in order
item.description: Runs from a fresh workspace reset, captures manifest values, exercises the complete success/error/state-change flow, and finishes with a clean reset. Select this folder in the Postman Collection Runner; do not run the exploratory folder as part of the sequence.

item.name: Student B initially has no active bookings

exec: pm.test('Fresh reset leaves Student B with no active bookings', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });

item.name: Draft service slots are absent from public results

exec: pm.test('Draft service has no publicly visible slots', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });

item.name: Create valid booking as Student B

exec: pm.test('Location header points to created record', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.eql('/api/bookings/' + pm.environment.get('createdBookingId')); });

item.name: Student B reads Student A booking
Student B cancels Student A booking
Student B cancels own new booking

exec: pm.test('Prior booking remains as canceled history', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('canceled'); });

item.description: Run independently in any order after importing an environment. Requests that need an existing booking explicitly name that prerequisite.

item.name: List Student B bookings (identity set per request)
item.description: Prerequisite: workspace handout loaded. Returns only the explicitly authenticated Student B's bookings.

item.name: Try an unknown query parameter
item.description: No prerequisite. Unknown filters are rejected rather than silently ignored.

item.name: Read one public slot
item.description: Prerequisite: a reset has populated availableSlotId in this environment.

item.name: Read a booking as its owner
item.description: Prerequisite: a reset has populated studentABookingId. Student A is explicitly selected on this request.

item.description: No prerequisite. Resets only the key's workspace. Clears the local createdBookingId.
